shared_menu_notes.navigation: same complete grouped menu entries as home-v1; dialogs are access points, not full configuration pages
shared_menu_notes.main.admin_tenant_activate: tenant selector demo clears incident content for unavailable tenant; no network
shared_menu_notes.main.logo_image: existing static CIR logo used in mock; runtime organization-logo capability unchanged
shared_menu_notes.static: logo/photo/css/js assets local; standalone deliverable embeds these
shared_menu_notes.ai_chatbot.widget_ask: AlBot optional plugin entry retained, widget conversation not reproduced
shared_menu_notes.admin_scope: configuration/users/workflow/audit groups limited to tenant admin or superuser; Tenants Default/global-ui/bootstrap only superuser

general_fields.recipient_lookup: external and LDAP configured access points; no directory search in mock
general_fields.date_now: deterministic fixture timestamp used by mock Adesso buttons; runtime must use application timezone

roles.tenant_scope: Active tenant always scopes incident detail, including superuser; legacy null tenant available via existing compatibility rules
roles.operator: Own incidents only, no write through can_write
roles.defaults: Tenants Default is configuration/catalogue-only, no operational incidents

workflow.lower: Clickable task type description, action label description/name, configured condition/deadline/document hints
workflow.arrows: Only ordered workflows; desktop horizontal, mobile vertical visual preservation
activation_priority: section_target: open section with redirect/action label/template context
requires_notification and not notification_done: missing documents redirects to forms/documents or ready opens notification preview
else: open action form and preselect action label
specific_blocking: global_check action cannot be recorded until prior steps complete
required notification task cannot be manually recorded before notification action
closure blocked if missing required steps produce procedural warnings
generation blocked if mapped required incident fields missing
notification sender validates recipients, incident-owned selected documents, required document selection
builtin username admin cannot send notifications; can explicitly confirm without send via separate confirmed mode
workflow.completion: Action counts match logical label kind/value with ID fallback; repeated tasks consume distinct action counts
workflow.deadlines: Hours from first initial-information action; not a universally assumed legal deadline
workflow.obsolete: No new assignment/clone; existing incident with unchanged workflow remains operable

prototype_api: window.CIRIncidentReview: role/tenant/capability switching and destination inspection for isolated validation only
field_preservation_note: Visible strings are fictional examples. Runtime selects/hidden inputs must continue to submit true tenant-scoped IDs, including collision-remapped catalogue IDs.
